`docs/项目持久化说明.md` points future sessions to the unified workspace.

Create a unified workspace for continued execution.
Update persistence docs to point at the new workspace.
evidence_hint: Root tree + unified workspace files + docs updated

Copy UI, runbooks, and docs from `usb-pack/` source directories.

Run legacy workspace init scripts.
Run shell syntax checks and record evidence.

Implement Docker baseline assets and shared runtime entrypoints.
Validate container status flow and sync longrun/docs.

Switch packaging sources to canonical root wrappers/docs/scripts and vendor runtime bundles.
Validate shell syntax and rebuild the staging pack before syncing handoff records.
evidence_hint: Spec-008 + dist tree + bash -n output + synced handoff logs

`platforms/mac/wrappers/01-开始部署.command` launches the UI service directly without prompting for CLI credentials.
Runbook and unified progress log capture the status/reset/entrypoint contracts.
steps: Refactor runtime status probing to separate daemon state, fallback health, and raw port occupancy.
Guard dashboard routing with reset-aware status checks and force-setup handling.
Add a canonical macOS UI-first launcher and sync runbook/progress evidence.
evidence_hint: Spec-003 + runbook F-005 + status/reset syntax checks + unified progress entry

description: Windows one-click deployment no longer assumes historical profiles live under a hardcoded `C:\Users` root; it resolves candidate home directories from environment variables and Windows user profile APIs.
acceptance_criteria: `platforms/windows/wrappers/one-click-deploy.ps1` does not hardcode `C:\Users` when locating existing `.openclaw-<profile>` state.
Historical profile detection still prefers the current user's home when config already exists, and can fall back to discovered Windows user homes for elevated-launch scenarios.
Affected Windows delivery docs and unified longrun records mention the new discovery strategy.
steps: Replace hardcoded Windows user-root scanning with environment-driven candidate homes.
Add Windows profile API fallback for non-standard home locations.
Sync Windows delivery docs and unified progress records.
evidence_hint: one-click-deploy.ps1 diff + docs/usb-pack/windows-native-delivery.md note + longrun entry
